CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2629 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61. Bus nonce: 8d5be6d3893125ceb8861682c4cb8703. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61` or `Fix review: blocked b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8d5be6d3893125ceb8861682c4cb8703`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2629 b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2629-8d5be6d3`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, round 2, PR #2629 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET. Head b7d2b645faf0a440f269b5734d16025058d53e61. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Round 1 (git fetch origin probe/rev-2629-5c5034eb; read verdict.md) blocked on unpinned sites: the --window-cache wiring in the record job, and two cache guards (a failed enumeration cached or served, and a foreign-key file served). Verify the round-2 delta:
1. Each new check fails on its mutant and passes on the fix:
   - the R1 and R1b acceptance arm in tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs (a failing pulls stand-in is read twice: fetched twice, no file left, write guard);
   - the R2 foreign-key arm;
   - the two tests/entities.py checks on the record job's five --window-cache invocations (null: all five found; mutants M1-yaml and Y1 fail).
   Run your own mutants, not only the fixer's.
2. Acceptance reads FIXTURE ok: 92 error(s) hold 253 pins. mutation_table.py --pin-killed --base origin/main reports 0 new unpinned sites.
3. The fixer measured at 63a4dce67 and then update_pr merged main again into b7d2b645. Re-run the touched checks at the real head.
4. The body (sha1 24ff8c3b): carry_audit pr 2629 reads 0 unrouted and 0 bad. The toolchain carry now names R10-FLY-CLOUD-SETUP-TOOLCHAIN.
5. Read CI at the head from check-runs. Answer every red in ## Red checks.
Round 1's other evidence carries over unless the code it covered moved.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
